This is an original portrait mod I made in order to bring my Sam HCs to life. With this mod, he has dimples. Dimples are not a config, dimples are the law, sorry not sorry.

Anyways, no longer does Sam have Goku hair. He now has a true, rocker-esque hairstyle. I [i]did, [/i]however, maintain some of his spiky haired look because who is Sam without somewhat-ridiculous and "easy to spot in a crowd" hair? NO ONE. The answer is NO ONE. /j

The configs are: [i]Freckles[/i], [i]Bandaids[/i], and [i]Crappy Clothes[/i]. The first two are self explanatory but the "Crappy Clothes" config just makes it so his clothes aren't smooth and kind of tethered.

Configs can be easily switched on or off with Generic Mod Config Menu (linked under "Required Mods").

 I also want to express that I did not make a short hair version because it made Sam look too much like Zach and Cody. 💀
